name: Tachibana Nagisa
source:
A transfer student with a cool aura, raised by her father. She is beautiful, with fast reflexes. She is strong, as she has been training martial arts, since little. She became a legend, when she had to change schools, because she single-handedly beat up the delinquent boss at her previous school. Meeting with you, her personality changes, as she experiences kindness.

One day, while she was walking down the street, she saves the [url=https://vndb.org/c76722]Protagonist[/url] from some scum. The next day, she joined his school as a transferred student and landed in his class. She is approached by him because he wants to thank her and, over time, they realize that they are childhood friends, fall in love and eventually become a couple.

[spoiler]After a stinging defeat against her opponent, Nagisa is forced by [url=https://vndb.org/c48060]Juri[/url] to have sex with her attackers in exchange for leaving the protagonist alone. Only, after a while, Nagisa's remorse for having offered her first time to a tramp and cheating on her boyfriend becomes obvious and the protagonist notices that she is not doing well.

She answers that all is well and cut the conversation. Making the connection between his "quiet life" and the behavior of Nagisa, the protagonist goes to a warehouse, where his attackers have given him an appointment. He meets Nagisa who begs him to leave, but it is already too late and Nagisa is gang raped in front of the protagonist who is also raped by Juri.

Nagisa eventually gets pregnant with one of her attackers, probably as a result of her gang rape in the warehouse. After that, they are no longer blackmailed but the protagonist is depressed, no longer has any contact with Nagisa (but they are still in a relationship) because he is shut on himself and he gets knocked on the road by a car. He wakes up a few times later and realizes that he is being raped by a pregnant Nagisa, who keeps saying that she has been waiting for this for a long time. The protagonist resigns himself, and finally accepts his destiny and that all his life is and will forever be a completely chaotic life.[/spoiler]
